title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode7 A Chance Meeting

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: The day of the Fan Festival
Fan Festival Venue

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there's Ena!
Hey, over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Finally made it! Sorry for keeping you two waiting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
We got here early too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
Wait, where's Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She isn't here yet.
It's not like her to be late.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. She usually arrives early whenever we meet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?
Sorry I'm late, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-That's fine and all, but why are you talking like that...?
Oh, hello there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on, Airi and Shizuku are here too...? And that other girl's...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No way! It's Haruka!!
I don't believe it! She's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Pipe down, will you. Everyone's gonna start staring if you keep shouting like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoops. Sorry!
But this means you're all here in secret, right?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we are, but there's no need to treat me any differently from anybody else. You're Ena and Mizuki, yes? It's nice to finally meet you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's her idol smile...
She's literally glowing too...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, we definitely weren't expecting to see Mafuyu bring the three of you in tow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Asahina and I are actually in the same club.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
She mentioned that during one of our after-parties.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's always so helpful too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, stop. You're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But what brings you here today?
Are you here to meet up with someone else?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Incidentally, a member of our group is performing today. We just happened to run into Asahina on our way to the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku introduced us to her and she told us about how she's in the same group as you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is such a nice surprise♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Who are these people...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You haven't met Airi and the others yet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade, meet my friends, Airi and Shizuku. They're both famous idols.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And this is Haruka!
The Haruka Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess idols really aren't your thing, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: M-Mafuyu speaking like this is starting to make my head hurt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, this is Kanade! She's the songwriter for our group and has a talent for composing really amazing music!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.
I'd love to hear your music sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N-Nice to meet you too. M-Maybe later...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, since we've been given this wonderful opportunity, why don't we all see the show together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd like that too...
I really want to do that but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Today's supposed to be a fun day off. It'd be awful to make her stay in “good girl” mode like this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, we'll be going as a foursome today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh. I see. That's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But that's understandable.
You came here as a group, so you should enjoy today as a group.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, Airi.
Let's try and talk later if we can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, see you then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Back to being yourself, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Myself?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I guess you really can't tell, huh?
You right now is the Mafuyu Asahina that we've gotten to know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Also, idols are way too cute!
I still can't believe that I got to meet Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There are so many different kinds of artists here today, including the idols we just met.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So many attendees too. I suppose it's a reflection of the wide range of genres being showcased here...)
Hey, I made it!

That makes all of us.
Shall we?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I'm just imagining things...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuuum♪
I can't wait to see Ichi perform!
I wonder what she's gonna sing♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Hehe. It'll be our first time being in the audience as Ichika sings, so I'm really looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this is sort of a rare opportunity for us, isn't it? We really haven't heard her perform like this before.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, there's more people here than I expected. I hope Ichika's doing okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That crossed my mind too. I hope she isn't getting too nervous...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then let's head over and show her that she has our support! That should help her, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't just barge in backstage, you know? She isn't the only one performing today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I meant all of us going at once would be a problem. If just one of us went, you might be able to actually see her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
But who...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I vote for... Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
Shouldn't you go, Saki? You're the best out of all of us at cheering people up...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I think she'd benefit more from seeing you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, you're already a veteran of the stage, and you're the musical pillar of our band!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I think what you say would mean more to her than anything I'd have to say!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree with Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please, Shiho, let Ichika know that she has our support.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll make sure to tell her that when I see her.
